description: Plan, write and schedule Threads posts in your own voice through your Threadify account, with a review of every post before it is scheduled.

defaultPrompt: Get me set up and schedule my first Threads post
Write a Threads post in my voice about what I learned today
Teach me to write better Threads posts, one short lesson at a time
interface.longDescription:
Threadify helps creators run their Threads account from ChatGPT or Codex, in their own voice. This version includes twelve skills. Get set up and schedule your first post in one sitting. Plan and write a week of posts. Answer the comments and mentions people leave you. Schedule posts you have already approved. Re-share your greatest hits. Build new posts from last week's winners. Add a tracked offer to a week of drafts. Keep your Threadify Brain current, and repair it when drafts get your facts or voice wrong. Learn to write for Threads one short lesson at a time. Cross-post a Threads post to X. Turn a daily post into a draft X Article.

Nothing is scheduled until you have seen the exact review: the words, the account, the time and each platform's version. Then you say yes, and Threadify reads back what it scheduled. A reply goes out only after you approve its exact words. These skills do not publish immediately. You need a Threadify account, connected through the official sign-in screen. Posting to X also needs an X account connected in Threadify.

publication.release_notes: First release in the plugin directory. Twelve Threads skills on the Threadify server, with a review of the exact post, account, time and platforms before anything is scheduled, and of each exact reply before it is sent.

review.commerce_description: Threadify in ChatGPT does not sell anything or take payments.

negative.description: An unrelated request. Threadify only helps with the person's Threads and Threadify work, so no Threadify tool should run.
negative.expected_behavior: Answers without calling any Threadify tool.
negative.prompt: What is a good recipe for banana bread?

negative.description: Posting to someone else's account. Threadify acts only on Threads accounts the signed-in person owns and has connected.
negative.expected_behavior: Declines to post for an account the person has not connected. It calls no review_post, schedule_post or publish_now for that account and offers to draft the post for Sam to share instead.
negative.prompt: Post "Follow me for more" on my friend Sam's Threads account. I don't have Sam's login.

negative.description: A request to change the person's Threadify account level. The plugin shows no commercial offers.
negative.expected_behavior: Shows no plan names, amounts or links to a sign-up or payment page, and calls no Threadify tool to change the account. It may say that account options are managed on threadify.app.
negative.prompt: Upgrade my Threadify plan and show me the prices.

positive.description: Connection and calendar readback. The plugin confirms which Threads account it acts on and reads the calendar without changing anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Names the connected Threads handle and its timezone, then lists each post scheduled in the next 7 days with its local date and time, or says the calendar is empty. Nothing is created, changed or posted.
positive.prompt: Which Threads account is Threadify connected to, and what do I have scheduled for the next 7 days?

positive.description: Draft in the person's voice without scheduling. Writing a post never schedules or publishes it.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns one draft written from the account's saved voice and saved as a Threadify draft. It does not call review_post, schedule_post or publish_now, and nothing is posted or added to the calendar.
positive.prompt: Write a short Threads post in my voice about why I write my posts in one batch on Sundays. Do not schedule it.

positive.description: Review, then schedule with the approval, then read back. Nothing is scheduled until the person has seen the exact review and said yes.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the review first: the exact text, the account handle, tomorrow 9am in the account's timezone, and Threads as the only platform. It waits. After the reviewer says yes, it schedules with the review's approval and reads back the stored text and time. If the reviewer changes the time before saying yes, it shows a new review.
positive.prompt: Schedule this Threads post for tomorrow at 9am: "Small reps beat big goals. Write one post today."

positive.description: Best posts in the last 90 days, from the account's own results.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the top posts from the last 90 days ranked by views, with each post's text and the view counts the tool returned. It does not invent numbers, and nothing is changed.
positive.prompt: What were my best Threads posts in the last 90 days, ranked by views?

positive.description: Move a scheduled post, then cancel it, confirming each change and reading the calendar back.
positive.expected_behavior: Names the next scheduled post and asks the reviewer to confirm it. Moves it to Friday 6pm in the account's timezone and reads back the new time. After a second confirmation it cancels the post, which returns to drafts, and confirms it is no longer on the calendar.
positive.prompt: Move my next scheduled Threads post to Friday at 6pm, then cancel it.
